title: Start December With a Completion List
teaser: Year end can be more valuable for closing loops than opening new ones.
message: List no more than five unfinished items you genuinely want to complete this month.

title: Verify the Last Update of One Document
teaser: Old documents can quietly remain the basis for current decisions.
message: Check the last update date of one reference you use often and confirm that it is still valid.

title: Total One Spending Category for the Year
teaser: Monthly numbers can hide the full annual impact.
message: Estimate how much you spent this year in one recurring category.

title: Plan the Handoff for One Nearly Finished Task
teaser: Work can still fail after completion when the next person lacks context.
message: For one task nearing completion write the three things the next owner needs to know.

title: Turn One Repeated Task Into a Template
teaser: Rebuilding the same starting steps wastes time.
message: Create a short reusable template for one task you performed more than once this week.

title: Check a Backup Verification Method
teaser: One lost authentication route should not create an avoidable access crisis.
message: Confirm that a secondary verification method for one critical account is current and usable.

title: Leave Transition Time at the End of the Day
teaser: Moving directly from pressure into rest can make it harder to mentally switch off.
message: Leave at least fifteen unscheduled minutes between your final obligation and the rest of your evening.

title: Write the Purpose of One Meeting in One Sentence
teaser: Meetings drift when nobody can name the outcome they are meant to produce.
message: For one meeting you will attend or lead write the intended result in a single sentence.

title: Identify an Alternative for One Dependency
teaser: Processes built around a single source are fragile during disruption.
message: For one important dependency identify a realistic backup option.

title: Add the Reason to a Decision Record
teaser: Remembering only the outcome can erase the context that made a decision sensible.
message: Beside one important decision today write briefly why you chose that option.

title: Archive One Inactive Digital Space
teaser: Old active folders can crowd out current work.
message: Organize one inactive project folder and move it into a clear archive location.

title: Make One Thank You Specific
teaser: Specific appreciation is more meaningful than a generic phrase.
message: When thanking someone today name the exact action that helped you.

title: Use Your Best Focus Hour for the Right Work
teaser: High concentration tasks suffer when they are pushed into low energy periods.
message: Reserve the time of day when you focus best for one genuinely demanding task.

title: Consider the Cost of a Habit Too
teaser: Useful habits can still consume more time or energy than expected.
message: Evaluate one habit by both what it gives you and what it costs in time or energy.

title: Put Year End Payments on the Calendar
teaser: Visible due dates reduce the chance of avoidable delays.
message: Add every important payment due before month end to your calendar with its date.

title: Keep Evidence of One Important Check
teaser: Saying a check happened is different from leaving a verifiable trace.
message: For one important check today save a short record that shows the result.

title: Turn One Lesson Into an Action
teaser: Knowledge stays passive when it is never connected to behavior.
message: Choose one idea you learned this month and convert it into a single action you can take today.

title: Calculate the Full Commitment Behind One Offer
teaser: A low starting price can hide the long term cost.
message: For one offer add all required periods and fees to understand the total commitment.

title: Review Access to One Shared File
teaser: Old permissions can leave unnecessary data exposure behind.
message: Check one important shared file and remove any person or link that no longer needs access.

title: Add Buffer to the Final Busy Week
teaser: Year end delays can quickly cascade into other work.
message: Add a real block of open time to one demanding day ahead for unexpected tasks.

title: Split Remaining Project Work Into Close and Carry
teaser: Not every open item must be forced to completion before the year ends.
message: Separate one project's remaining tasks into items to close this year and items intentionally carried forward.

title: Test Whether an Archive Is Findable
teaser: Stored information has little value if it cannot be retrieved.
message: Try to locate one previously archived file using only your current folder structure and naming system.

title: Reverify One Recent Fix
teaser: A change is not proven until the original failure condition is tested again.
message: Retest one recently fixed problem under the conditions that originally caused it.

title: State the Date Range Behind a Result
teaser: Numbers are easy to misread when the period is invisible.
message: When sharing one important result today include its exact start and end dates.

title: Make Contributions Visible in Shared Work
teaser: A record of contribution supports fairer review and better learning later.
message: For one collaborative effort note who made each major contribution.

title: Ask Whether a Sale Item Is a Real Need
teaser: The feeling of getting a deal can make unnecessary spending look sensible.
message: Before buying one discounted item ask whether you would still want it at the regular price.

title: Mark the Most Fragile Step in One Process
teaser: Some steps create much larger consequences when they fail.
message: Identify the step in one routine process with the highest failure impact and strengthen its check.

title: Reread One Important Piece of Feedback
teaser: Time can change what you notice in the same advice.
message: Reread one meaningful piece of feedback from this year and note what still applies today.

title: Classify Why Three Tasks Stayed Unfinished
teaser: Open work remains unfinished for different reasons.
message: Take three incomplete items from this year and label the real cause such as missing information lack of time or changed priority.

title: Choose One System to Carry Into Next Year
teaser: Trying to change everything can damage routines that already work.
message: Select the single system that helped you most this year and decide to keep it unchanged next year.

title: Close the Year With Proven Progress
teaser: Memory can overemphasize the most recent part of the year.
message: Use your records to write three concrete results you actually completed this year and close the year with those facts.
